title: Site setup and next actions
intro: Local configuration and recorded observations only. Open a settings page to explicitly test a connection; configuration alone does not prove operation.
identity_help: Review the site title, language and visual identity.
content_help: Publish the essential pages your visitors need.
menus_help: Assign a menu with links to a theme location.
email_help: Configuration and current saved delivery-test evidence are shown separately. A passed test records server acceptance, not inbox receipt.
ai_help: Optional server-side provider configuration; no request is sent here.
cloudflare_help: A saved credential is not a verified account or a successful operation.
edge_help: Manage independent instances. An identity check does not test all runtime operations or synchronize this site.
storage_help: Review the selected local or remote destination and test it explicitly.
backups_help: The last successful backup record does not prove the file still exists or that restoration was tested.
readiness_help: This checks the local database only. Open health for broader diagnostics.
modules_help: Review active modules, dependencies and configuration.
identity_only: Connected means manager identity verified, not operation-tested. Checks run only when you press Check.
label: Label
empty: No saved instances. Connect an existing instance below.
connect_help: The manager key is sent only to the server for verification and encrypted storage. It is never displayed again.
request_failed: Request failed. Reload to get the current revision before retrying.
creation_separate: Creation is experimental and creates an independent empty site; it does not copy this Full site.
plan_help: Preview resource names and account checks first. Creating resources requires a separate explicit approval. Administrator setup remains separate.
approve: I approve creating these exact resources in this account.
write_warning: Read checks cannot verify write permissions. Provider writes may fail and require reconciliation.
identity_failed: Identity check failed; review connection settings.
plan_error: Creation stopped. Review the recorded stage and technical receipts before reconciling; do not repeat an uncertain creation.
connections_help: Saved evidence applies to this profile version and expires. A connectivity check is not an operation test.
plan_state.stale: Plan changed or expired · preview again
